process_steps.input_state: aluminum cans, pure Fe, Cr, Ti

evidence.quote: Two Al95.1 ± 0.2Fe2.4 ± 0.1Cr1.5 ± 0.1Ti1.0 ± 0.09 (at%) ingots were produced in an induction furnace using aluminum cans (without the can endcap) and pure Fe, Cr, and Ti ( > 99.9 wt%) in two steps.

The Al95.1 ± 0.2Fe2.4 ± 0.1Cr1.5 ± 0.1Ti1.0 ± 0.09 (at%) ingots were atomized in a gas atomizer (PSI Hermiga 75/5VI) using argon as atomization gas with 40 bar of pressure. The gas-to-melt mass flow ratio (GMR) used was 1.7.

other.scanning strategy: one-way, vectors rotated by 79° in adjacent layers

evidence.quote: The Al95Fe2Cr2Ti1 powder was processed using the process parameters: 30 µm layer thickness, a one-way scanning strategy with 129 W laser power, 300 mm/s scanning speed, 60 µm laser spot size, 102 µm hatch spacing.
